Jerome Robbins joined NYCB the following year and, with Balanchine, helped to build the astounding repertory and firmly establish the Company in New York. The New York City Ballet performed at the opening ceremony for Saratoga Performing Arts Center in 1966 and returns each year for their summer residency.
